system.description:
You can construct traps using your abundant knowledge of weapons and tools. Over the course of 10 minutes, you can spend 2 Discipline to construct a mundane trap found in Chapter 5: Equipment, Adventuring Gear following the rules found in the Traps section as if you have a Trappers Kit. You can construct Traps of a Rank equal to the highest rank jutsu you knows following the Weapon Specialist Class table.

If you do have a Trappers Kit when you use this Kata, you can add 1 Flurry Die to your check results to craft the Trap.
